item.name: Default
item.unlock: Given to every player from their first join.
item.cardSummary: The starter base every account begins with. Its plain look is also the game's default index reward track: completing the no-mutation index grants a 0.5x cash multiplier instead of a new skin.

item.name: Gold
item.unlock: Complete 75 percent of the Gold mutation index.
item.cardSummary: A gilded base for Gold index hunters. Finishing the index also adds a 0.5x cash multiplier, so the shine comes with a payout.

item.name: Diamond
item.unlock: Complete 75 percent of the Diamond mutation index.
item.cardSummary: The Diamond index reward, and like the other classic skins it stacks a 0.5x multiplier on top of the new look.

item.name: Rainbow
item.unlock: Complete 75 percent of the Rainbow mutation index.
item.cardSummary: An animated RGB base that cycles colors, earned from the Rainbow index along with a 0.5x multiplier. The flashiest of the classic four.

item.name: Candy
item.unlock: Complete the Candy mutation index (brainrots added before July 25, 2025).
item.cardSummary: The first mutation-season base. Its index demands every eligible Candy brainrot, which makes it a completionist badge more than a casual unlock.

item.name: Lava
item.unlock: Complete the Lava mutation index (brainrots added before August 23, 2025).
item.cardSummary: A molten-themed base from the Lava season, needing the full Lava index to unlock.

item.name: Galaxy
item.unlock: Complete the Galaxy mutation index (brainrots added before September 27, 2025).
item.cardSummary: A starfield base from the Galaxy season, unlocked by finishing that season's full index.

item.name: Yin-Yang
item.unlock: Complete 75 percent of the Yin-Yang mutation index (brainrots added before November 15, 2025).
item.cardSummary: The balance-themed season base, and the first mutation skin to drop its requirement from 100 to 75 percent.

item.name: Radioactive
item.unlock: Complete 75 percent of the Radioactive mutation index (brainrots added before January 3, 2026).
item.cardSummary: A glowing hazard-green base from the Radioactive season.

item.name: Cursed
item.unlock: Complete 60 percent of the Cursed mutation index (brainrots added before February 21, 2026).
item.cardSummary: The Cursed season base, part of the friendlier 60 percent era of mutation indexes.

item.name: Divine
item.unlock: Complete 60 percent of the Divine mutation index (brainrots added before April 18, 2026).
item.cardSummary: A radiant base from the Divine season at the 60 percent index threshold.

item.name: Cyber
item.unlock: Complete 60 percent of the Cyber mutation index (brainrots added before June 13, 2026).
item.cardSummary: A neon tech base from the Cyber season.

item.name: Phantom
item.unlock: Complete 60 percent of the Phantom mutation index (brainrots added from June 13, 2026).
item.cardSummary: The ghostly Phantom season base at the 60 percent threshold.

item.name: Crystal
item.unlock: Complete 60 percent of the Crystal mutation index (brainrots added from July 25, 2026).
item.cardSummary: The newest mutation base, from the Crystal season. Listed as not yet earnable while its season index is still filling out.

item.name: Halloween
item.unlock: Complete 75 percent of the Halloween event brainrot index during the event.
item.cardSummary: The first seasonal base, from the 2025 Halloween event window.

item.name: Aquatic
item.unlock: Complete 90 percent of the Fishing Event's Aquatic index during the event.
item.cardSummary: The Fishing Event reward base, one of the tougher seasonal indexes at 90 percent.

item.name: Christmas
item.unlock: Complete 90 percent of the Christmas index during the event.
item.cardSummary: The winter event base from the Christmas index.

item.name: Gingerbread
item.unlock: Bought during the Christmas event; purchase included a Premium Festive Lucky Block.
item.cardSummary: A purchasable Christmas base that bundled a Premium Festive Lucky Block, making it part skin, part loot deal.

item.name: Taco
item.unlock: Index 20 of 22 Taco brainrots while the Taco base event is active.
item.cardSummary: An oddball event base that the developer occasionally re-enables for short windows, tied to the Taco brainrot index.

item.name: Valentine's
item.unlock: Index 8 of 12 Valentine's brainrots during the event.
item.cardSummary: The Valentine's event base, earned through that event's small brainrot index.

item.name: Rose
item.unlock: Bought during the Valentine's event; purchase included a Premium Heart Lucky Block.
item.cardSummary: The purchasable half of the Valentine's pair, bundled with a Premium Heart Lucky Block.

item.name: Pot of Gold
item.unlock: Bought during the St. Patrick's event; purchase included a Premium Leprechaun Lucky Block.
item.cardSummary: The buyable St. Patrick's base, sold alongside a Premium Leprechaun Lucky Block.

item.name: Lucky
item.unlock: Index 8 of 12 Lucky brainrots during the event.
item.cardSummary: The earned half of the St. Patrick's pair, tied to the Lucky brainrot index.

item.name: Bunny Basket
item.unlock: Bought during the Easter event; purchase included a Premium Egg Lucky Block.
item.cardSummary: The purchasable Easter base, bundled with a Premium Egg Lucky Block.

item.name: Easter
item.unlock: Index 10 of 13 Easter brainrots during the event.
item.cardSummary: The earned Easter base from that event's brainrot index.

item.name: Summer
item.unlock: Index 18 of 20 Summer brainrots during the event.
item.cardSummary: The Summer event base, with one of the strictest seasonal ratios at 18 of 20.

item.name: Red Octo
item.unlock: Bought during its event; purchase included a Premium Octo Lucky Block.
item.cardSummary: A purchasable event base themed on the Octo brainrots, bundled with a Premium Octo Lucky Block.

item.name: Skibidi
item.unlock: Have a Skibidi Toilet brainrot in your base.
item.cardSummary: An OG base that activates simply by owning one of the rarest classic brainrots. The skin is easy; the Skibidi Toilet is the hard part.

item.name: John Pork
item.unlock: Have a John Pork brainrot in your base.
item.cardSummary: The John Pork owner's base, a status skin that advertises one of the most traded OG brainrots.

item.name: Headless Horseman
item.unlock: Have a Headless Horseman brainrot in your base.
item.cardSummary: The Halloween-flavored OG base, unlocked by housing the Headless Horseman.

item.name: Meowl
item.unlock: Have a Meowl brainrot in your base.
item.cardSummary: The Meowl owner's base from the first OG skin wave.

item.name: Strawberry
item.unlock: Have a Strawberry Elephant brainrot in your base.
item.cardSummary: The Strawberry Elephant's matching base, from the first OG skin wave.

item.name: Spyder
item.unlock: Have a Spyder Elephant brainrot in your base.
item.cardSummary: The newest OG base, tied to the Spyder Elephant.

item.name: SpyderSammy's Base (New)
item.unlock: Appears only during admin abuse events run by the developer; not unlockable by players.
item.cardSummary: The developer's current event base. During admin abuses it spawns on the map holding stealable secrets, but it never joins player inventories.

item.name: SpyderSammy's Base (Old)
item.unlock: Retired version of the developer's event base, replaced by the newer design.
item.cardSummary: The middle iteration of Sammy's admin base, kept here as history.

item.name: SpyderSammy's Base (Legacy)
item.unlock: The original developer event base from the game's early admin abuses.
item.cardSummary: The first version of Sammy's admin base, from the game's earliest admin abuse events.

item.name: Tralalero Base
item.unlock: Granted through codes handed out during admin abuse events.
item.cardSummary: The first base modeled on an actual brainrot, distributed only through admin abuse codes.
